verdict.rationale: Discord exposes a Gateway API for receiving server events and webhooks/bot tokens for posting messages, which developers can combine to build custom automations that react to events (e.g., a bot listening for messages and firing responses). However, this requires building and hosting a custom bot/app via code — there is no evidence of a native, declarative 'if event X then action Y' rule builder accessible to non-developer end users. Missing for 10: a built-in no-code rule/trigger UI (e.g., AutoMod-style rule definitions), first-party workflow/automation builder, and evidence that ordinary users (not developers) can define these rules without writing bot code.
